groups.title: Command-line tools, each with its own site.
groups.lead: Released from signed tags. A release publishes its module here, and the card shows the version go.octolab.org serves.

groups.title: Packages for your own Go code.
groups.lead: The root module and the toolkits around it. Import them with their go.octolab.org path; the API reference lives on pkg.go.dev.

groups.title: Where a new module, tool or service starts.
groups.lead: Project templates with their build, checks and release pipeline already in place.

groups.title: Small utilities and the services of earlier years.
groups.lead: Still resolvable under their import paths. Most of them have not released through the catalog yet: go get takes the latest tag or commit of the repository.

items.title: maintainer
items.tagline: See all of your open source. Move it every day.
items.summary: A local hub shows every checkout and every issue across your repositories in one place, and one CLI keeps the checkouts current and plans your next contribution.

items.title: indexit
items.summary: Describe Telegram users, bots and channels, export conversations as JSON Lines and keep the photos of a post in your notes, served by a local image service.

items.title: pulse
items.tagline: Your morning, with a hand on the pulse.
items.summary: The GitHub trends of trendshift.io and github.com as one calm morning paper that shows only what you have not seen. Keep what matters in one click.

items.title: pkg
items.summary: The root module of go.octolab.org: small packages for everyday Go code, among them async, errors, safe, sequence, strings, sync and testing.

items.title: cli
items.summary: Packages for command-line programs: helpers for cobra, a debugger, errors and a graceful shutdown.

items.title: config
items.summary: Configuration of a Go program, with a package for its HTTP settings.

items.title: protocol
items.summary: HTTP for services: headers, a server, middleware for chi and a REST router.

items.title: propaganda
items.summary: Middleware and a round tripper that carry headers from the request a service receives to the requests it makes.

items.title: go-module
items.tagline: Template for a typical module written in Go.
items.summary: A library module with its Makefile, linters, tests and release workflow ready on the first commit.

items.title: go-tool
items.tagline: Template for a typical CLI tool written in Go.
items.summary: A command-line tool with its commands, configuration, build and release pipeline in place.

items.title: go-service
items.tagline: Template for a typical service written in Go.
items.summary: A service and its client over an RPC API, with the build and release pipeline that a new service starts with.

items.title: try
items.summary: A command-line tool on top of the kamilsk/retry package: run a command again until it succeeds, with a limit and a backoff.

items.title: breakit
items.tagline: Execute commands for a limited time.
items.summary: Run a command and stop it after a deadline, as in breakit after 10m -- server run.

items.title: parallel
items.summary: A command-line tool on top of the kamilsk/semaphore package: queue commands and run them with a limit on how many run at once.

items.title: testit
items.summary: Shortcuts around go test, such as compiling every package without running a test, and output with absolute paths, colors and stack traces.

items.title: Tuna
items.summary: Test and compare LLM prompts across several models from the command line: write the prompts, define test queries and see how each model responds.

items.title: fiddle
items.summary: An RSS manager at its very start: the repository still holds the CLI template it grows from.

items.title: Forma
items.summary: Your personal server for HTML forms, with accounts and a command line to manage them.

items.title: Guard
items.summary: Your personal guard that restricts access to content to those with a paid subscription.

items.title: Passport
items.summary: Your personal user tracker and authentication service.

items.title: Tablo
items.tagline: The one point of view to all your task boards.
items.summary: A service that brings task boards from GitHub and Trello into one view.

items.title: sparkle
items.tagline: A personal development framework and knowledge platform.
items.summary: The service of the Sparkle framework for personal knowledge management, with its sparkle command line.

items.title: telemost
items.tagline: Telegram bridge for AI and automation.
items.summary: A service at its very start: the repository still holds the service template it grows from.
